title: Get a licence to busk or perform in public places
what: Get the council's licence before busking or performing in streets or other public places.

laws.title: City of Swan Activities in Thoroughfares and Public Places and Trading Local Law 2026

sources.title: City of Swan Activities in Thoroughfares and Public Places and Trading Local Law 2026
sources.locator: cl 8.16, as made, Gazette No. 101, 5 Aug 2026
sources.quote: A person shall not set up or conduct street entertainment in a thoroughfare or public place unless—

sources.title: City of Swan Activities in Thoroughfares and Public Places and Trading Local Law 2026
sources.locator: cl 8.16, as made, Gazette No. 101, 5 Aug 2026
sources.quote: (a) the person has obtained approval from the local government and is the holder of a valid and current street entertainment licence;

confidence_note: Quotes the local law as made, from the WA Government Gazette; WA publishes no consolidated local laws. The clause was found by a pattern search of every Gazette from 1996 to 2026 (E-8), and the law was taken as in force because no later repeal naming it was found.

assessment.summary: Performing in public places needs the council's licence.
